statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ),
  0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c r) → (f c).re = (2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, (f (circleMap c r t)).re

goal.text: (f c).re = (2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, (f (circleMap c r t)).re
goal.rhs: (2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, (f (circleMap c r t)).re
